_description: Perfect negative stock/bond correlation with matched volatility. Each year the bond shock exactly mirrors the stock shock in log-return space, so the two lognormal factors combine to a very tight portfolio factor (cosh-shaped around the mean). Dispersion of final balances collapses near the deterministic path.
_rationale: 50/50 allocation with stockReturn = bondReturn = 0.05 and stockStdDev = bondStdDev = 0.10. With correlation enabled and rho = -1, yearly return variance at the portfolio level is (sigma^2/2) * (1 + rho) = 0 (to first order), so median and downside paths should converge near the deterministic expected balance of 500000 * 1.05^10 ≈ 814447. Log-normal Jensen gives a tiny upward bias. Tight range around deterministic confirms correlation is being applied.
name: Correlation: Perfect Negative
